# Diagnostic seam witnesses

Pinned public reference geometry from the retained 19 October checkpoint and
integrated Stage 1.1 correction. Source hashes and exact section/target keys are
retained in `diagnostic-witnesses.json`. These are correspondence diagnostics,
not personal journeys or new evidence admissions.
